title: Anthropic Launches Beta Linked Billing Feature on Claude Platform: Connecting the Ecosystem Loop and Opening OAuth Billing Testing for Third-Party Apps

content_html:
AI platforms are taking a key step on the path to building an open ecosystem. According to reports from multiple media outlets, including Wallstreetcn, Cailian Press, and Hithink RoyalFlush Finance, AI giant Anthropic recently officially launched a beta linked billing feature on the Claude platform and simultaneously kicked off linked billing OAuth testing for third-party applications.

Opening Up Ecosystem Connectivity: OAuth Billing Testing Goes Fully Live

As large models gradually evolve from single-purpose conversational tools into agents and multi-application platforms with complex workflows, how to enable smooth commercial collaboration between third-party applications and underlying large models has become a core focus for major tech companies.

The core of Anthropic's beta linked billing feature is to connect the account and billing pathways between the platform and third-party services. By launching linked billing OAuth testing for third-party applications, developers and ecosystem partners can securely and properly link external application calls with users' Claude account system and billing.

This move not only simplifies users' payment and settlement experience, but also lays a solid underlying infrastructure for the future large-scale onboarding and commercial monetization of more third-party plugins, tools, and Agent services on the Claude platform.
